rows.abstract: "Government Reorganization Act of 1998". Decalres it a policy of the State to develop and maintain a government bureaucracy whose scope, level and focus of functions, programs and activities support the national development goals and efforts; and whose size, organizational structure and operating systems promote economy, efficiency, innovation and productivity. Prescribes the scope, principles and standards or reorganization; provides safety nets for those who may be separated as a result of this reorganization. Creates the COMMISSION OF REORGANIZATION primary responsible for the drafting of an Integrated Reorganization Plan.

rows.abstract: Criminalizes INCEST and prescribes stiffer penalties for violation thereof.
